description: Grant or withdraw ONE consent scope: followup (project long-term follow-up — the project profile is stored on VCP servers), usage_collection (usage-experience collection), alliance (alliance membership — needs usage_collection first), publish_reviews (publishing identifiable reviews). Granting ANY scope needs a server-issued one-time receipt: request one with consent_request_receipt, confirm it on the VCP confirmation page in the user's own signed-in VibeCodePicks browser session, then pass its receipt id as `receipt`. A plain source string is never proof for any scope. Scopes are never bundled: granting one never grants another, and alliance never implies publish_reviews. Withdrawing a scope blocks new writes under it immediately. Owner credential only.
name: consent_update
title: Update consent
